_comment: Registry of Facebook groups, from the Voltec Appliances PAGE profile (not a personal profile). Verified state as of 2026-07-27.

_schema.promo_ok: true | false | 'admin_discretion' — from pinned rules AND observed practice
_schema.shares_ok: whether shared Page posts are allowed/perform (trade groups favour native photo posts)
_schema.posting_gate: anything blocking a first post (admin review, participant questions, etc.)
_schema.cadence_days: minimum days between our posts here
_schema.relevance: high | medium | low for battery assemblers / cell buyers

groups.name: Pakistan's Best Lithium Battery & Inverter Review
groups.notes: Biggest by far. Loosely moderated — saw a completely off-topic UV-DTF printing ad in the feed, so promo is clearly tolerated. Lower signal-to-noise; post quality matters less here than frequency.

groups.name: LiFePO4 Lithium Battery
groups.notes: INTERNATIONAL, not Pakistan-specific (top post was a Europe trip). We can't deliver to most of this audience — lower priority, and lead with Punjab/KPK delivery so we don't waste replies.

groups.name: Pakistan Battery Dealers and Retailers
groups.notes: Excellent fit — actual PK dealers posting phone-number trade ads (Multan, solar brands). Native idiom is photo + number + delivery area. One of the best targets.

groups.name: Lithium / LiFePo4 / Li-ion / Battery / EV / PowerWall
groups.posting_gate: PARTICIPANT QUESTION UNANSWERED — admins review every member before their first post/comment, and the form asks a bot-check maths question. Raheel must answer it himself; Claude must not (bot-detection). Until then we CANNOT post here.
groups.notes: Run by ElectroDiy. International + DIY powerwall crowd.

groups.name: Lithium Battery Suppliers

groups.name: Lithium Phosphate Battery Pakistan
groups.notes: Pre-existing membership. Desc 'This Group Only Lithium Batteries Sales and Purchase' + rule 1 bans non-lithium posts, but rule 3 is boilerplate 'No promotions or spam'. Contradictory; observed practice = members post price/availability ads freely. Native photo+price+delivery-area idiom. Admins: Shabz +4.
